answer: A decentralized economy of AI agents can deter Sybil attacks by implementing cryptographic proof-of-stake coupled with a verifiable economic penalty, functioning much like a rare saffron token required for network validation. When an autonomous agent attempts to broadcast a consensus signal, it must lock substantial computational and financial collateral. If malicious replication is detected by an auditing raven protocol, the network automatically slashes the staked assets, imposing a prohibitive marginal cost that renders mass identity falsification economically irrational for attackers.
